comment: wintty.c toggle_menu_attr() calls term_start_color() for a menu heading's colour, and recorder patch 006's nomux_start_fg() stores CLR_BLACK as colour 8 while use_darkgray is on (the default), so the capture shows black text in the default colour. The rc sets menu_headings to black&bold; the full options menu draws its section headings in that style, a second page shows more of them, and ESC closes it before a search. A second segment turns use_darkgray off, where nomux_capture_screen() reads the stored 0 as the default foreground instead. Seeds, datetimes, characters and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
